title: Memories at the Seashore | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Gulf front designer townhome with private elevator, bikes, all suite bedrooms, and Gulf facing balcony.
description_expanded: Memories at the Seashore Designer Gulf-front Townhome with pool, private elevator, gourmet kitchen, and bikes Home Introduction Relax and find your muse at Memories at the Seashore, our 4 bedroom, 4.5 bath Gulf front townhome only 8 minutes to Pier Park. This designer home is bathed in color, design, and natural light to create an atmosphere inspired by the tranquil blue waters just outside your door. Home Highlights Beachfront Townhome - incredible views throughout the home plus a private entrance to the beach Community Pool - enjoy the Gulf-facing pool, only shared with 4 other townhomes 4 Taxi Bikes Outdoor Living - Gulf facing patio with outdoor lounge, dining area, and a private entrance to the beach Private Residential Elevator - travels to all floors Gourmet Kitchen - stocked with high-end brands like Samsung and Gauggeneau Steam Oven Private Workspaces in both king suites Sleeping for 14 Guests in all ensuite bedrooms - 2 King suites, 1 bunk suite, and a deluxe guest suite Laundry Room Smart TVs with cable and WiFI Dedicated Parking for 2 Vehicles (additional parking not available) Complete Clean Linen Program - All linens laundered after every stay Location Perks Beachfront living! 8 minutes to shopping and dining at Pier Park 3 minutes to Thomas Donut and Snack Shop 8 minutes to Frank Brown Park Know Before You Go A mid-stay clean is required for bookings 10+ days (included in rate) Concierge available for add-ons like eBikes, beach bonfires, beach chair and umbrella setup, and chef services

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
